faqs.q: Is there a limit on product options?
faqs.a: No. Add as many product options as each product needs.

faqs.q: What kinds of options can I add?
faqs.a: Text fields, dropdowns, radio buttons, swatches, file uploads and custom size inputs, combined however you need.
Yes. Set dynamic pricing on options so the price follows each choice.

faqs.q: Can I reuse options across products?
faqs.a: Yes. Build an option set once and apply it to any of your products.
